allOf.description: intent.accept is the only transition to protected status (plan §5.4); an accepted record must carry its acceptance record.

A superseded record names its successor (RFC 0037 R6, ID3): supersession is what moves a record out of head position, and a record that records the status without the edge leaves the lineage unwalkable from itself.

description: Registry status of an Intent Contract: Proposed vs accepted, the acceptance audit record, and the §4.2.1 signature chain honored on bundle import.

chain.description: Signature chain for §4.2.1 intent-bundle import; an imported acceptance is honored only if this chain satisfies the local policy.

schema_id.description: Artifact-class identity of the governing schema: its `$id` with the `v<schema_epoch>/` segment removed (schemas/README.md). Stable across schema epochs.

schema_epoch.description: Schema epoch this instance was written against (schemas/README.md). It advances only on a breaking change to this artifact class, is not one of the six independently versioned epochs (RFC 0026 `rule versioning.epoch_independence`), and pins no semantics.

status.description: Import never changes protection status: an imported Proposed contract stays proposed (plan §4.2.1).

supersedes.$comment: RFC 0037 F10, paid here. The record carried no predecessor or successor pointer, so the common ancestor the three-way merge requires (M1 — the nearest contract reachable from both heads through registry lineage) was not recoverable from the record alone. Optional at schema_epoch 1: a lineage root has no predecessor, and records written before this field existed stay valid.
supersedes.description: The contract this one supersedes — the registry lineage edge (`SUPERSEDES`) M1 walks to find a common ancestor. Null for a lineage root. `intent.lock` and `intent.accept` both mint a successor identity, so a revision always has one (RFC 0037 ID3, R6).

superseded_by.description: The contract that superseded this one; null while this record is the lineage head. Required when `status` is `superseded`. Acceptance and supersession are not in the `in_*` identity preimage (RFC 0037 ID4), so recording them here changes no contract identity.

title: Intent Registry Record
